plate_verses.1: The blessed of the Lord Jesus
plate_verses.5: “and opening His mouth, He taught them, saying:” (Mt 5:2)
plate_verses.7: “…because they are the kingdom of heaven” (Mt 5:3b)
plate_verses.12: “Blessed are those who are hungry and thirsty for righteousness” (Mt 5:6a)
plate_verses.19: “…because they will be called children of God” (Mt 5:9b)
plate_verses.20: “Blessed are those who are persecuted for the sake of righteousness” (Mt 5:10a)
plate_verses.21: “…because they are the kingdom of heaven” (Mt 5:10b)
plate_verses.22: “Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you, and falsely say all kinds of evil things about you because of Me” (Mt 5:11)
plate_verses.23: “Be glad and rejoice because great will be your reward in heaven” (Mt 5:12a)
plate_verses.24: “…because in this same way, the spokespeople who came before you were also persecuted” (Mt 5:12b)
plate_verses.25: “When He saw the crowds, He climbed the hillside and sat down” (Mt 5:1a)
plate_verses.27: He gave instructions to freely share this work among His joyful.
plate_verses.28: The smallest ones in the Kingdom of Heaven.
